coverage: complete saved model/forecast blocks; account evaluation remains separate

methods.errors: Pooled candidate-row squared error; block MSE weighted by matching model/baseline row count. No test selection or refitting. Training-only setup means are diagnostic comparator. This differs from dollar/equal-date inner family-selection loss.
methods.reliability: Each raw/corrected output uses its own calibration prediction quintiles; duplicate edges collapsed. All finite future outcomes included per head, missing outcomes counted. Per-block numeric bins are preserved below.
methods.utility: Before quantity/cash/fees minima: U/N=0.998*mu-0.004-0.5*downside from saved corrected predictions, proportional 40bps only. This is a forecast qualification statistic, not realized profit, fill probability or an account return.
methods.overlap: Candidate rows and holding periods overlap; no independent observation claim or statistical significance test.
methods.continuation: Status-only operational amendment retained in identities; no model, threshold or selection change.

highest_calibration_interval.interpretation: Each block highest calibration-defined interval; numeric thresholds differ, duplicate edges may collapse bins.
